name: pr-review-bot
description: GitHub Action that reviews pull requests: size, missing tests, leftover TODO/console.log, new dependencies and their licenses — summarised in a single, self-updating comment.

scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.review:local: ncc build scripts/local-review.ts -o lib/local-review -q && node lib/local-review/index.js
